label: preparing
what: Likely a community supper and service acknowledgement for the mayor in the great hall at eighteen, presented to me as a lighting inspection. Builder is arranging the acknowledgement and arrival with neighbour; neighbour solicits bread and grain and will escort me; innkeeper coordinates hospitality. Baker's involvement is suggested by reports of discussions at the bakery, but not directly confirmed. Freight is reportedly receiving contributions. Secretary recorded the inspection appointment, but knowing involvement in the undisclosed celebration is not established.
